_about: Ranges for modern species (those that lived into the last few hundred thousand years). Times are in years before present. Each phase lists regions: {countries}, {continents}, {country, bbox} to clip part of a country, {box} for open sea (or land then above sea level), {sea} for water only (a box with today's land cut out), and latMin/latMax/lonMin/lonMax to clip any region. lastSeen marks where the last one was seen alive (shown as a skull flag at the centre of that country until that date).
